create_collagemaker: create a CollageMaker instance with prompts, segmented data, background image, and CLIP model for collage generation
initialise_collagemaker: initialise a CollageMaker from checkpoint or perform random search over hyperparameters for optimization
loop_collagemaker: run the main optimization loop for collage generation with optional video frame capture
